i.norm: For the Discordian chronology there is only a single era (YOLD), and the proleptic year is defined to be identical to the year-of-era. This test verifies that {@code prolepticYear} simply echoes the supplied year-of-era back when the era is the (only) valid Discordian era.
The era of any Discordian date is always YOLD, the chronology's single era.
